copy.curiosityHook: When a vengeful cop joins forces with an undercover agent masquerading as a ruthless hitman, can their volatile alliance crack the smuggling ring before their cover shatters?
copy.description: After his partner dies in a deadly shoot-out with gun smugglers, a grieving Hong Kong cop teams up with an undercover officer posing as a mob hitman, deploying relentless force to penetrate the syndicate's inner circle.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and relentlessly exciting, this high-energy Hong Kong thriller demands engaged attention for explosive action nights.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Woo, this fast-paced crime thriller channels kinetic shoot-outs and high-stakes tension into an electrifying, action-packed hunt through the criminal underworld.

allowedMaterial: Cop losing his partner during a shoot-out with gun smugglers
Mission to catch the smugglers and dismantle the ring
Teaming up with an undercover cop posing as a gangster hitman
Use of excessive force to reach the ringleaders
Hong Kong setting, John Woo direction, action-crime-thriller tone
excludedMaterial: Climax details and hospital sequence specifics not in source
Fates of the central characters beyond initial partner death
True identities of syndicate leaders not named in overview
Third-act resolutions or final body counts
